timeline.title: Duisburg blast furnace 1: cooling stave leak
timeline.text: Water in the furnace: the largest furnace in Europe goes off wind for about thirty hours.

timeline.title: Storm closes IJmuiden: no vessels for 36 hours
timeline.text: A North Sea storm closes the port. Ore and pellet deliveries to Velsen fall to a fifth.

timeline.title: ERCOT: scarcity prices forecast tomorrow 15:00-19:00 CST
timeline.text: A Texas heat wave: the grid operator expects 1,500 USD/MWh for four hours tomorrow afternoon.

timeline.title: Hazira: gas curtailed to 45 % for pipeline maintenance
timeline.text: The pipeline operator curtails the site's gas for thirty hours. Direct reduction needs most of it.

timeline.title: Tubarao hot strip mill: main drive fault
timeline.text: A drive motor fails. Twelve hours without rolling; the slabs keep coming from the casters.

timeline.title: Duisburg blast furnace 1 back on wind
ERCOT at 1,500 USD/MWh
timeline.text: An arc furnace hour in Corpus Christi now costs more than the steel it melts is worth.

timeline.title: Tubarao hot strip mill rolling again
North American automotive customers pull orders forward
timeline.text: Two car makers call off a quarter more coated coil for the next forty hours.

timeline.title: European scrap jumps to 470 USD/t
timeline.text: Export demand empties the dealers' yards. Shredded scrap rises by a fifth overnight.

timeline.title: Monterrey arc furnace: transformer trip
timeline.text: The furnace transformer trips on a fault. Eight hours without melting.
